items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: He was a piano player, too. He was a piano player, too.

ctx.x: He was a man. He was a man. He never stayed up like me. We might stand up and be blowing away. Son was sit right there. And before you know it, the musicians don't stop making them stand around. People stop dancing. You sit down there and, oh, man, boy.
He was a piano player, too. He was a piano player, too.

He was a good piano player, good piano player. But he was an alto. Yeah. Good piano player, boy. This is how you should teach him. Yeah. Yeah, he did. Man, boy, that kid's real some sex, boy. He was easy.
